protocolName: UK PoMS Flower-Insect Timed Count (form v6, 2023)
protocolDescription: Count for exactly 10 minutes every insect that sits on or lands on the target flowers within a 50 x 50 cm patch, counting each individual once, in ten insect groups (insects of uncertain type go to 'Other insects'). Spiders and caterpillars are not counted. Counts are made 1 April to 30 September in dry, warm weather: minimum 13 °C if less than half cloud, 15 °C if half cloud or more. Sky: all or mostly blue / half blue and half cloud / all or mostly cloud. Patch sun: entirely in sunshine / partly in sun and partly shaded / entirely shaded. Wind: leaves still or moving occasionally / moving gently all the time / moving strongly. Target flower cover of patch: less than half / about half / more than half. Patch setting: in a larger patch of the same flower / in a larger patch of many different flowers / more or less isolated.
